plan.summary: Opening the store now removes a lock file left by a crashed process. `clear_stale_lock` was a no-op. It now deletes the lock file at `lock_path(dir)`. A missing file is not an error. Any other I/O error is returned to the caller.
plan.riskRationale: One small function changes in one file. The behavior is narrow: delete a lock file and ignore NotFound. No tests are in the diff. Removing a lock that a live process still holds could be a concern, but the diff does not show how callers decide a lock is stale.
plan.storyArc: The PR replaces a no-op stub with real stale-lock cleanup. One topic covers the whole change.

topics.title: clear_stale_lock removes the lock file and tolerates NotFound
topics.narrativeBrief: What does clear_stale_lock do now, and which errors does it return? Verify in the source who calls it and whether it checks that the lock is actually stale before removal.
